description:
Problem: the local review has no dispute path. Its only escape is a unilateral 'Local oracle override:' line in the PR body that the reviewer never sees, bound to no head or finding, persisting forever. Local findings are unrecordable, so CI starts blind and re-raises them under new ids.

Outcome (owner Q1, Q4):
- The driver keeps a FindingsRecord per patch (normalised digest) with the same structure CI reconstructs from its marker and threads: finding ids (c<cycle>-D<n>), severity, location, title, fingerprint, status, rebuttals, dispositions and round counts.
- Local rebuttals come from a rebuttal input keyed by finding id, and re-judgement runs the same dispute rules (keyed, evidence both ways, 2 rounds, escalation).
- Local owner adjudication is an explicit option on the same invocation, recorded in the record.
- make pr-open embeds the record in the PR body as a hidden marker. CI's first plan ingests it as claims: identity, rebuttal text and round counts carry; authority never does. Every locally withdrawn or adjudicated finding enters CI as disputed and needs an explicit CI disposition.
- The override line, its parser and its docs are deleted.

Decision gates:
1. A forged or edited record may only create work (forced dispositions); it can never clear or downgrade a finding or confer strikes. Prove with tests.
2. CI ignores a record whose digest does not match the PR's patch digest.
3. Local owner adjudication carries to CI as a claim only; CI escalation still needs the owner's adjudication comment on the PR (documented).

Item guardrails: the local review posts nothing itself; CI decision rules unchanged except ingesting claims.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build whose SHA-256 that item records, verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge, a stand-in, an adjudication, or a ruleset or settings change. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
